question: Suppose $P$ and $Q$ are the centres of two disjoint circles $C_1$ and $C_2$ respectively, such that $P$ lies outside $C_2$ and $Q$ lies outside $C_1$. Two tangents are drawn from the point $P$ to the circle $C_2$, which intersect the circle $C_1$ at points $A$ and $B$. Similarly, two tangents are drawn from the point $Q$ to the circle $C_1$, which intersect the circle $C_2$ at points $M$ and $N$. Show that $AB=MN$.

source.title: Test of Mathematics at the 10 + 2 Level
